CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_mfa_satisfied(target_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    target_organization_id is not null
    and (
      coalesce((
        select not oss.require_mfa_for_all_users
        from public.organization_security_settings oss
        where oss.organization_id = target_organization_id
      ), true)
      or coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', '') = 'aal2'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.enterprise_member_can_manage(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select p_organization_id is not null
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.organization_members om
      where om.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and lower(coalesce(om.status, '')) = 'active'
        and om.user_id = auth.uid()
        and lower(coalesce(om.role, 'viewer')) in ('owner', 'admin', 'editor', 'compliance_manager')
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.enterprise_member_can_read(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select p_organization_id is not null
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.organization_members om
      where om.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and lower(coalesce(om.status, '')) = 'active'
        and om.user_id = auth.uid()
    );
$function$
